description: Return { count } — the TOTAL number of leads matching a filter, without fetching any rows. Accepts the exact same filters as list_leads (search, category, status, campaign_id, no_campaign, owner_id, min_score, stale_days). Use this to size a segment before listing/exporting (e.g. how many stale leads, how many in a campaign).

custom.description: Filter on lead custom fields (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'): { key: value } — value = equals (multiselect: contains), array = any of (multiselect: contains all), null = empty. E.g. { "stufe": "A", "marken": ["KTM"] }.

min_score.description: Only count leads with at least this score (0-100)

no_campaign.description: Only leads not assigned to any campaign

stale_days.description: Only leads whose last activity is older than N days

name: count_leads
